name: Egg Festival
tips: BUY STRAWBERRY SEEDS (100g each)! The most important thing you'll do this festival. Buy 10+ if you can afford it. Egg hunt for Star Tokens.

name: Flower Dance
tips: Dance with any villager if you have 4+ hearts. Talk to all NPCs for friendship boosts.

name: Luau
tips: Add a Gold or Iridium quality item to the potluck soup. Iridium = Governor approves, big town friendship boost.

name: Dance of the Moonlight Jellies
tips: Just show up and enjoy the cinematic. All NPCs are there for easy friendship scenes.

name: Stardew Valley Fair
tips: Grange Display: place 9 Gold/Iridium quality items from different categories. Win Star Tokens for Stardrop or speed boosts!

name: Spirit's Eve
tips: Navigate the haunted maze. Reach the prize room for a Golden Pumpkin (rare crafting ingredient).

name: Festival of Ice
tips: Ice fishing contest. Use Iridium Rod with Trap Bobber and Bait. Win for extra Star Token prizes.

name: Night Market
tips: Visit ALL 3 nights! Magic Shop Boat sells rare items (Pearl, rare furniture). Submarine Fishing gets Midnight Carp and rare fish.

name: Feast of Winter Star
tips: You'll be assigned a secret gift recipient. Give a universally loved item (Golden Pumpkin, Pearl, Rabbit's Foot) for max friendship.
